reserveReview.rationale: The September 29, 2026 Chronicle source payload directly identifies STAC fund NAV of $281,895,415.70 and 49 named CLO positions with aggregate portfolio market value $277,571,572.67, plus cash of $1,297,805.81 and other net assets/liabilities of $3,026,037.24. The static reserve row remains the single 100% fund-NAV identity emitted by the live chronicle-nav adapter; its high-risk public-credit classification describes the identified fund claim, not a claim that every underlying asset is a CLO tranche. No PGIM AAA CLO ETF appears in this dated portfolio. Chronicle technically verifies third-party source data and expressly disclaims underlying-data attestation or audit. The older July position census and its maturity maximum are not carried forward.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Chronicle September 29, 2026 dated fund-NAV proof and position census; single fund-share scoring bucket matching the live chronicle-nav adapter
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The full reserve row identifies the STAC fund-NAV claim, so no reserve row is unidentified. Underlying cash counterparties, other net assets/liabilities, and fund legal terms are not disclosed by this proof; no gross unknown-exposure percentage is inferred from net balances. The 49 named CLO positions have individual maturities, but those dates do not establish a contractual maturity maximum for the fund share.
